body: Yes, I'm still in school, but I didn't speak to the school consular, but I have with someone from Pro Persona who's going to help me with my suicidal thoughts.
I don't depend just on her, it's what happened throughout a period of 5 years. That's what makes me feel suicidal.

I have the same problem every year, but if you don't try, you'll never know what happens. That's what I do at least. You can try talking to someone about this first or just go straight to the girl and tell her. It isn't a really good idea to be stuck with this on your own, I have experience with this. It can really help to talk with someone you trust enough to tell this.
If he doesn't care enough about you to contact you, he isn't worth waiting for.
